# Independent installed native header CLI pipeline

All six genuine identities below passed in 15.47 seconds on required Linux at
`b76805d8` / source tree `8ede01a7`, with zero failures/errors/skips. This is focused
installed CLI/joined-pipeline evidence; exact final shared CI and platform acceptance
remain pending. The earlier 37 SDK and 31 crawler cases are separate evidence and
were not repeated by this cohort. The immutable oracle remains descriptive;
its historical `runtime_acceptance: not-run` field is not the execution verdict.

Terminal evidence retains 19 production source-to-wheel-to-installed bindings,
36 original terminal processes and six settled two-origin owners. Sixteen offline
entry metrics reported zero forbidden acquisition calls. Both denials recorded zero
store reads/Saves/contacts, and replay/reuse/report made zero Saves. The joined
pipeline recorded seven actual GETs (four crawl, three capture), zero sentinel
contacts and header-field accuracy TP2/TN1/FP0/FN0 over its three original cases.
Actual original roles, distinct source identities and triage survived relocated replay.

`tests/functional/test_native_header_cli_pipeline.py` registers all four shared
fixtures explicitly. The module-scoped installed wheel depends only on session
platform/evidence owners; function-scoped evidence owns each actual case. A clean
source commit/tree, fixed source hashes, bounded original build/install logs,
wheel digest/member hashes and actual isolated import identities bind every
command, crawler, capture and header module used here. No fake platform or executor
can satisfy a required positive. Linux runs genuinely; unsupported ordinary lanes
are explicitly unassessed, and required unsupported lanes fail.

The fixture owns two held ephemeral literal `127.0.0.1` origins. Its main origin
has exactly four selected URLs: one independently authored seed and the existing
`/zap-passive/missing`, `/zap-passive/fixed`, `/zap-passive/body-decoy` routes. The
seed contains exactly three links. There are no remote fixture controls, outbound
targets or new acquisition paths. The sentinel admits zero original connections.
Both origins reuse reviewed accept-time socket/dispatch ownership, two-second
whole-request deadlines and three-second cleanup. The frozen original catalog
`fb57a1e31904e9904ef5501a6dc7721c9263e12ab55672405c5a70fb2c3798d7`
is unchanged. Its source bytes are used; descriptive ZAP counts are ignored.

| Identity                                                          | Required actual result                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ScoresActualOriginalFields[missing]`                             | Capture CLI ACKs seven roles; offline CLI saves one Finding                                                                      |
| `ScoresActualOriginalFields[fixed]`                               | Capture CLI ACKs seven roles; offline CLI saves one negative assessment                                                          |
| `ScoresActualOriginalFields[body-decoy]`                          | Body-only field text remains one saved positive Finding                                                                          |
| `DeniesBeforeStoreReadsOrOriginalContacts[missing-opt-in]`        | Exit 3, no store read/Save, no workspace and zero contacts                                                                       |
| `DeniesBeforeStoreReadsOrOriginalContacts[raw-url]`               | Noncanonical raw URL exits 2 before normalization/store access; zero contacts                                                    |
| `OwnNativePipelineRetainsDistinctSourcesTriageAndRelocatedReplay` | Four crawl GETs, three separately approved capture GETs, offline 1/0/1, triage/reuse, removed-root relocation, replay and report |

Live crawl, live capture and offline header interpretation each use a separate
explicit policy and opt-in. Discovery does not trigger another workflow. The
pipeline retains both structural crawler and legacy exact-URL capture Endpoint
identities without merging them. Original receipts and seven roles come only
from actual capture returns; actual owner Save acknowledgements are observed,
never synthesized from reopened state. One explicit triage uses the existing
canonical disposition API. Exact analysis reuse must perform zero Saves.

Capture/crawl invoke the actual installed `python -I -B -m fuzzy1337` entry point.
Offline checks/replays/report invoke that same installed `__main__` through a fixed
isolated process and `runpy`, with exact product arguments retained. Tripwires
forbid target/process/thread/helper acquisition, capture/crawl entry, policy
Plan/Authorize and evidence Put/publication; they do not replace analysis or owner
Save results. The listener has already closed and joined before offline work.
The relocated canonical workspace and evidence are moved together; the original
root must be absent before historical replay. Replay/report preserve the actual
model, requests, original bytes, Finding identities and operator disposition.

Per-case evidence mirrors into `functional-evidence/native-header-cli/run-*/case-*`,
which existing CI uploads. Every actual process retains original argv, raw
stdout/stderr, return code or actual timeout prefix before parsing/assertions.
Build streams have a 1 MiB retention ceiling; consumers 8 MiB, at most 32 processes
per case, 35 seconds each (fixed setup/triage: 10 seconds). Build/install phases
are separately bounded at 40 seconds. Seven-role original bytes/manifests,
offline tripwire/read/Save facts and actual post-both-cleanup counters, partial
contacts, sent bytes, mechanism errors and owner state remain available on failure.
Only fixed owned inputs/evidence are uploaded; no entire environment or workspace.
Accuracy is written only after all case assertions complete; failed work is
unassessed, never a negative.

The reviewed focused cohort selection is:

```bash
FUZZY1337_RUN_NATIVE_HEADER_CLI_ACCEPTANCE=1 \
  python -m pytest tests/functional/test_native_header_cli_pipeline.py \
  --no-cov -n 2 --dist=loadscope
```

The pure source/constructor counterexamples in
`tests/unit/test_native_header_pipeline_source.py` create no socket, thread,
worker, installed environment or capture. No release or general target-scanning
acceptance is implied by these finite cases.
